description: Holds an incoming phasor at its current position for as long as FREEZE is high, then carries on from that position

params.text: The position in the cycle the phasor jumps to when RESET fires; centred is the start of the cycle
Scales the RESET PHASE CV before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1
Holds the phasor at its current position while the button is held down
Jumps the phasor to the position set by RESET PHASE

inputs.text: Modulates the reset position, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob
A high level here holds the phasor in place; the phasor moves again when the level drops
A rising edge jumps the phasor to the position set by RESET PHASE

outputs.text: The phasor, 0-10V, held in place while FREEZE is high

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
